description: This file defines a generic ObserverManager class for managing collections of observers, including subscription, unsubscription, notification, and expiration handling. It includes a derived class for addressable observers and uses concurrency-safe patterns with read snapshots.

classes.name: ObserverManager<TObserver>
classes.description: A specialized observer manager for IAddressable observers, initializing with expiration and logger.

classes.name: ObserverManager<TIdentity, TObserver>
classes.description: A generic, thread-safe collection managing observers with expiration, notification, and enumeration capabilities.

methods.name: ObserverManager(TimeSpan expiration, ILogger log)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the observer manager with expiration duration and logger.

methods.name: Subscribe(TIdentity id, TObserver observer)
methods.description: Adds or updates an observer subscription identified by id.

methods.name: Unsubscribe(TIdentity id)
methods.description: Removes an observer subscription by id.

methods.name: Notify(Func<TObserver, Task> notification, Func<TObserver, bool>? predicate = null)
methods.description: Asynchronously notifies all observers matching the predicate.

methods.name: Notify(Action<TObserver> notification, Func<TObserver, bool>? predicate = null)
methods.description: Synchronously notifies all observers matching the predicate.

methods.name: ClearExpired()
methods.description: Removes all expired observers based on last seen time.

methods.name: CreateReadSnapshot()
methods.description: Creates a read-only snapshot of current observers for thread-safe iteration.

methods.name: GetWritableObservers()
methods.description: Returns a writable copy of the observers dictionary, copying if necessary for thread safety.
